issues.message: COPILOT_ENTERPRISE and COPILOT_ORGS are both unset — skipping live Copilot Metrics collection.
issues.details: Set COPILOT_ENTERPRISE (enterprise-wide) or COPILOT_ORGS (comma-separated org slugs) as a repository/organization Actions variable to enable live metrics collection. Monthly Usage Report (CSV import) and other credential-independent features remain unaffected.
